Sample: fund-quarter panel, opentonewinv==1 and row-count event quarter j in -7..5 (j counts panel rows from the first post-signing row, so it differs from calendar distance when a fund's panel has gaps). Treatment D = post_pri = 1 from the fund's first post-signing quarter (absorbing in calendar time, verified); gvar = gpost. fixest (fixef.rm = none) reproduces the log: coef -0.001737472 vs -0.0017375, N 4041 vs 4041, clusters 519 vs 519, SE 0.004680379 vs 0.0046804. Regression sample: N = 4041, 519 funds, 41 consecutive quarters. Cohorts (first post-signing quarter): 40, of which 33 have both treated and untreated rows in the sample. In 40 of the 41 treated periods another cohort supplies untreated rows (not-yet-signed funds; no never-treated funds). Funds observed only after signing in the sample (always-treated within sample): 267 (31.2% of rows); funds observed only before signing: 17.
